convexHull.label: Convex hull
convexHull.description: Outermost polygon wrapping all stops—smooth and stable for sparse routes.

concaveHull.label: Concave hull
concaveHull.description: Tighter outline that follows clusters better than a plain convex hull.

boundingBox.label: Bounding rectangle
boundingBox.description: Axis-aligned box around stops—fast and easy to compare areas.

partitionNoOverlap.label: Partition (no overlap)
partitionNoOverlap.description: Convex outline per route, then trim overlaps in stable route order so shaded regions do not stack.

none.label: Routes only
none.description: Hide shaded regions; show sequence lines and stop markers only.

UiPlanWorkflow.title: Fleet plan wizard
UiPlanWorkflow.subtitle: Step-by-step: create a one-day plan, assign drivers and vehicles, add deliveries, preview routes on the map, confirm, then download reports.

stepHints.0: Pick service date, work plan template, and distribution center (route start). Next creates your fleet plan.
stepHints.1: Select which fleet vehicles participate in route generation. Combined capacity must cover all deliveries.
stepHints.2: Import Excel or add stops when manual entry is enabled for your organization.
stepHints.3: Choose clustering strategy and polygon style, generate draft routes, then preview on the map.
stepHints.4: Lock the plan when the preview matches what you want. Re-open here if you must adjust.
stepHints.5: Assign a driver to each route. Compare stops, path length, estimated duration, and cargo load per vehicle.
stepHints.6: Review counts and download fleet PDF, per-driver PDFs (ZIP), or JSON instructions.
